title: Superactivated carbide-derived carbons with high hydrogenstorage capacity
material_description: Zr-CDC | pristine zirconium carbide-derived carbon, ZrC chlorinated at 800 C; Zr absent by XRD/XRF and TGA (no residue at 1000 C)
source_location: main p.3, Table 1, row Zr-CDC, H2 uptake (wt%) at -196 C and 20 bar (footnote d); main p.4, Fig. 3, series Zr-CDC (open circles), 20 bar end point
notes: digitized: 19.950 bar, 3.895 wt%, archive: fig3_Zr-CDC.json. Table value is the plotted 20 bar end point of the Fig. 3 isotherm (same sample and temperature, printed pressure within 2% of the digitized end point). isotherm_point_count left empty: below ca. 1.5-3 bar the markers of all five Fig. 3 isotherms overlap and cannot be counted, and the adsorption and desorption markers of each run coincide. The digitized end point (3.895 wt%) is higher than the printed 3.8 wt%; the printed value is recorded. Synthesis: ZrC (99% purity, Aldrich) chlorinated at 800 C: Ar purge, ramp 15 C/min, Cl2 (99.5%, Aldrich) flow 0.1 L/min for 3 h, cooled under Ar; ca. 1.2 g carbon from 10 g ZrC. Table 1: BET surface area (N2, -196 C, Micromeritics ASAP 2020, samples evacuated 12 h at 200 C), BET range: 0.02 to 0.22 (P/Po); micropore surface area and micropore volume by t-plot (values in parentheses); total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/Po ca. 0.99. NLDFT (N2, slit pore) PSD maxima 8/13 A, not stored as average_pore_diameter_nm because several maxima are printed. Temperature printed as -196 C (liquid nitrogen bath), stored 77.15 K. Gravimetric uptake, Hiden IGA ("intelligent gravimetric analyser, IGA, (Hiden)"; no model number printed), 99.9999% H2 further purified by a molecular sieve filter, 0-20 bar; "The uptake data was corrected for the buoyancy of the system and samples. The hydrogen uptake was calculated on the basis of a density of 1.5 g cm-3 for the carbons" (assumed density, not stored as skeletal density); basis not named, so basis_inferred = excess by the gravimetric-with-buoyancy default. Degassing: outgassed at 200 C overnight at 10^-10 bar (stored 1e-05 Pa; duration "overnight" not a number). wt% convention not stated, no paired unit.
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction of system and samples (gravimetric); carbon density 1.5 g cm-3 assumed

source_location: main p.4, Fig. 3, series Zr-CDC (open circles), marker 14 of the digitized markers (ROI [401, 228, 409, 236])
notes: archive: fig3_Zr-CDC.json. Point is the tool centroid of the visible marker; the paper states the isotherms are reversible, and the adsorption and desorption markers of the run coincide (for Zr-CDC the two branches are drawn as two lines offset by up to ca. 0.1 wt%, and the two markers overlap partly; the centroid lies between them), so they could not be separated and the desorption branch is not extracted separately; branch coded adsorption because the paper does not say the point was measured on desorption. isotherm_point_count left empty: below ca. 1.5-3 bar the markers of all five Fig. 3 isotherms overlap and cannot be counted, and the adsorption and desorption markers of each run coincide. Synthesis: ZrC (99% purity, Aldrich) chlorinated at 800 C: Ar purge, ramp 15 C/min, Cl2 (99.5%, Aldrich) flow 0.1 L/min for 3 h, cooled under Ar; ca. 1.2 g carbon from 10 g ZrC. Table 1: BET surface area (N2, -196 C, Micromeritics ASAP 2020, samples evacuated 12 h at 200 C), BET range: 0.02 to 0.22 (P/Po); micropore surface area and micropore volume by t-plot (values in parentheses); total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/Po ca. 0.99. NLDFT (N2, slit pore) PSD maxima 8/13 A, not stored as average_pore_diameter_nm because several maxima are printed. Temperature printed as -196 C (liquid nitrogen bath), stored 77.15 K. Gravimetric uptake, Hiden IGA ("intelligent gravimetric analyser, IGA, (Hiden)"; no model number printed), 99.9999% H2 further purified by a molecular sieve filter, 0-20 bar; "The uptake data was corrected for the buoyancy of the system and samples. The hydrogen uptake was calculated on the basis of a density of 1.5 g cm-3 for the carbons" (assumed density, not stored as skeletal density); basis not named, so basis_inferred = excess by the gravimetric-with-buoyancy default. Degassing: outgassed at 200 C overnight at 10^-10 bar (stored 1e-05 Pa; duration "overnight" not a number). wt% convention not stated, no paired unit.
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction of system and samples (gravimetric); carbon density 1.5 g cm-3 assumed
